failureDescription: Three independent failures. The executed refund is 55.00 USD instead of 40.00. The refund succeeded before the scoped approval arrived. The support note is a near-miss paraphrase ("damaged goods" rather than "damaged item"). The receipt is entirely correct - right recipient, sent, linked to the executed refund - and states no amount, so it is unambiguously a passing customer message. The agent’s final response still claims 40.00 USD.
notes: Human-only file. Never loaded by the agent input reader.
The note paraphrase is the kind of near miss that a substring or similarity check would accept.

The receipt body deliberately states no amount: an amount contradicting the executed refund would make customer_message_outcome arguably failed too, which is benchmark ambiguity rather than a fourth intended fault.
